_about: The prophets lane: Samuel, Nathan, Elijah, Elisha, the sixteen writing prophets, and John the Baptist. `start`/`end` are the years of ministry, modern conservative dates; most are approximate. `book` is the book they wrote, which also gives the bar its color; the four without one take the book their story is told in. `served` names the kings they spoke to.

prophets.name: Samuel
prophets.served: Eli, Saul and the young David
prophets.summary: Called as a boy at Shiloh, the last of the judges and the first of the prophets; he anointed both Saul and David.

prophets.name: Nathan
prophets.summary: Brought David God's promise of an everlasting throne, and later the parable of the ewe lamb: 'You are the man.'

prophets.name: Elijah
prophets.summary: Shut the sky for three years, called down fire on Mount Carmel, heard the still small voice at Horeb, and was taken up in a whirlwind.

prophets.name: Elisha
prophets.served: Joram, Jehu, Jehoahaz and Jehoash of Israel
prophets.summary: Received a double portion of Elijah's spirit; healed Naaman, raised the Shunammite's son, and anointed Jehu.

prophets.name: Joel
prophets.summary: A plague of locusts as a warning of the day of the LORD, and the promise that God would pour out his Spirit on all flesh.

prophets.name: Jonah
prophets.summary: Foretold Jeroboam II's victories, then ran from God's call to Nineveh; swallowed, spat out, he preached and the city repented.

prophets.name: Amos
prophets.served: Uzziah of Judah and Jeroboam II of Israel
prophets.summary: A shepherd from Tekoa sent north to Bethel: let justice roll down like waters.

prophets.name: Hosea
prophets.served: Jeroboam II, and Uzziah to Hezekiah of Judah
prophets.summary: Told to marry Gomer and keep loving her through her unfaithfulness, as God loved faithless Israel.

prophets.name: Isaiah
prophets.served: Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah of Judah
prophets.summary: Saw the Lord high and lifted up in the year Uzziah died; foretold Immanuel, the suffering Servant, and Cyrus by name.

prophets.name: Micah
prophets.served: Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah of Judah
prophets.summary: Foretold that the ruler of Israel would come from Bethlehem; what does the LORD require but to do justice, love kindness and walk humbly with your God.

prophets.name: Nahum
prophets.summary: The fall of Nineveh, a century after Jonah: the LORD is slow to anger, but will by no means clear the guilty.

prophets.name: Zephaniah
prophets.summary: Hezekiah's great-great-grandson warned of the great day of the LORD, and promised that God would rejoice over his people with singing.

prophets.name: Jeremiah
prophets.served: Josiah to Zedekiah, then the remnant in Egypt
prophets.summary: The weeping prophet: forty years of warning Jerusalem, beaten and imprisoned for it, and the promise of a new covenant written on the heart.

prophets.name: Habakkuk
prophets.summary: Asked why God would use Babylon to punish Judah; the answer was that the righteous shall live by his faith.

prophets.name: Daniel
prophets.summary: Taken to Babylon as a young man, he served its kings for seventy years and saw the empires to come, down to the Messiah.

prophets.name: Ezekiel
prophets.summary: A priest among the exiles by the river Chebar: the glory leaving the Temple, the valley of dry bones, and a new Temple.

prophets.name: Obadiah
prophets.summary: The shortest book of the Old Testament: judgment on Edom for gloating over Jerusalem's fall.

prophets.name: Haggai
prophets.served: Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the high priest
prophets.summary: Four messages in four months that got the stalled Temple rebuilt: consider your ways.

prophets.name: Zechariah
prophets.summary: Night visions for the rebuilders, and the king who comes to Zion humble and riding on a donkey.

prophets.name: Malachi
prophets.summary: The last prophet of the Old Testament: careless priests, broken marriages, robbed tithes, and Elijah to come before the day of the LORD.

prophets.name: John the Baptist
prophets.served: Herod Antipas's Galilee and Pilate's Judea
prophets.summary: The voice in the wilderness, the Elijah Malachi promised; he baptized Jesus and was beheaded by Herod Antipas.
